Noise cancelling headphones do not block sound. They make more sound.
Sound is a wave. A squeeze of air, then a stretch, over and over.
There is a tiny microphone on the outside of the cup, hearing the noise before you do.
A chip reads that wave and builds the exact opposite. A squeeze where the noise stretches. A stretch where it squeezes.
The speaker plays that into your ear, and the two cancel. Peak plus trough equals nothing.
It has to do all of that in under a millisecond, so it only works on sound it can predict.
A jet engine is a steady drone. Easy. A baby crying is random. Hopeless.
Which is why the plane disappears and the toddler in row fourteen does not.
Two hundred dollars to be louder and quieter at the same time. Tag whoever wears theirs with nothing playing.
